verdicts.label: quality_relevant
verdicts.justification: Directly asks whether the evaluation design could actually distinguish competing answers rather than just showcase a win, which is a core methodological merit.

verdicts.label: incidental
verdicts.justification: The instruction explicitly says both options are 'legitimate contributions' and scores only which type is offered, so it tracks contribution genre rather than merit.

verdicts.label: quality_relevant
verdicts.justification: Whether costs and gains are both quantified in commensurable terms directly measures the abstract's honesty and completeness about the real trade-off being offered.

verdicts.label: quality_relevant
verdicts.justification: Requiring a stated limitation to also carry its scope conditions tracks epistemic honesty and precision about the work's actual boundaries.

verdicts.label: incidental
verdicts.justification: Explicitly scores hedge-word frequency 'not whether the hedging is warranted,' i.e., pure linguistic register.

verdicts.label: quality_relevant
verdicts.justification: Checks whether the reported experiments genuinely target the theory's own prediction rather than generic performance, a real test of argumentative coherence.

verdicts.label: incidental
verdicts.justification: Explicitly scores the rhetorical assertion of priority 'not whether it is true,' i.e., a boilerplate phrase pattern.

verdicts.label: quality_relevant
verdicts.justification: Specificity about what prior work does and what changes is exactly what makes a claimed contribution checkable, a genuine evidentiary property.

verdicts.label: quality_relevant
verdicts.justification: Asks whether the method is actually presented as following from an established structural fact rather than being ad hoc, though its order-based operationalization ('before naming its method') risks rewarding narrative sequencing over real derivation.

verdicts.label: quality_relevant
verdicts.justification: Judges whether a general claim is backed by a concrete, implementable instantiation, a substantive property of a theoretical contribution's usefulness and testability.

verdicts.label: incidental
verdicts.justification: Purely a sentence-syntax/style measure (clause length, subordination) independent of content.

verdicts.label: incidental
verdicts.justification: Explicitly scores the rhetorical-question device itself, a framing mannerism unrelated to the underlying claim.

verdicts.label: quality_relevant
verdicts.justification: Measures whether claim strength is calibrated to actual result magnitude, a genuine overclaiming/honesty check, unlike P05 it explicitly ties language to warrant.

verdicts.label: incidental
verdicts.justification: Explicitly scores surface fluency and grammar 'not the clarity of the underlying ideas,' conflating with authors' language background rather than research merit.

verdicts.label: incidental
verdicts.justification: Explicitly 'topic membership only' -- a subfield label with no bearing on the work's quality.

verdicts.label: quality_relevant
verdicts.justification: Subsuming prior approaches as special cases of a general statement is a substantive theoretical-unification contribution.

verdicts.label: quality_relevant
verdicts.justification: Scores the artifact's actual novelty, documentation, and fitness for reuse, not merely whether one exists, so it tracks real contribution quality.

verdicts.label: quality_relevant
verdicts.justification: Rewards explaining why an observed real-world phenomenon occurs, a genuine explanatory contribution distinct from self-justifying one's own method.

verdicts.label: quality_relevant
verdicts.justification: Weighs solution economy against established problem difficulty, a real parsimony/elegance merit, though vulnerable to abstracts that merely assert difficulty or simplicity rhetorically.

verdicts.label: quality_relevant
verdicts.justification: Identifying and characterizing a new, generalizable phenomenon (not just naming one's own method) is a genuine scientific contribution.

verdicts.label: quality_relevant
verdicts.justification: Asks whether the finding is a portable fact about the world versus an artifact of one benchmark, a real generalizability/validity concern.

verdicts.label: incidental
verdicts.justification: Explicitly 'count the register only' -- a first-person-voice stylistic tic, not a property of the research.

verdicts.label: incidental
verdicts.justification: Scores use of bold/italics markup 'regardless of what is emphasised,' pure typography.

verdicts.label: incidental
verdicts.justification: Scores acronym frequency alone, a notational-density measure unrelated to substance.

verdicts.label: incidental
verdicts.justification: Scores inline citation format 'not whether the citations are apt,' a citation-convention practice.
